caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, repetitive floral pattern arranged in a square format. There are four large stylized flowers, each with five rounded, scalloped brown petals forming an outer ring, an inner ring of green petals, and a smaller yellow star-shaped center. Each flower is oriented with one point toward a corner of the square. Between the flowers, small buds with pinkish-red petals and green leaves are distributed, connected by green stems. The background is light beige with fine, wavy lines creating a textured effect. Along the border of the square, moon-like crescents alternate in gold and green on each side, filling the edge space. The design uses a palette of brown, green, beige, yellow, and pinkish-red colors and is framed by a simple line border.
title: Applique and Quilted Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
